name: Cursed of Erech
game_text:
<keyword>Enduring</keyword>. To play, add a threat.
When you play Cursed of Erech, exert him twice.
At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert another <culture>Gondor</culture> Wraith to make Cursed of Erech <keyword>defender +1</keyword> until the regroup phase.
